Learn shows each new thing alone on a table (It is a watch.; headphones are They are headphones.); practice shows each cast member with one thing: Luis's watch, Diego's wallet, Ana's headphones, Sofia's camera. A Yes answer is chosen when the picture shows the thing; No answers stay in the text banks. Two Listen text cards bring back 1.8's don't and 1.11's with them.

lesson.title: 2.3 Things I have
lesson.unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
lesson.goal: Name four everyday things (a watch, a wallet, headphones, a camera) and say and ask who has them (Luis has a watch. / Do you have a camera? Yes, I do.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.3 Common Objects: A1 names a book, a pen, a phone, a bag, a chair and a table (It is a pen.); A1+ 2.3 names four more everyday things and who has them. It adds no new grammar relationship: A1's have/has and A1+ 1.5's Do you have…?, with 1.9's short answers (Luis has a watch. / Do you have a camera? Yes, I do. / Does Ana have headphones? Yes, she does.).
lesson.prerequisite: A1 2.3 objects and It is a…; A1 3.12 have/has; A1 7.6 listen to music; A1+ 1.5 Do you have…?; A1+ 1.8 don't; A1+ 1.9 Does…? Yes, she does.; A1+ 1.11 with them.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say watch with a short o-like vowel and a clear final ch, wallet with stress on the first syllable, headphones with stress on head, camera with three short syllables (CAM-er-a). Do not require native-like speed.
